name: capex-beas
description: Capex Guidance Change Monitor for BSE-listed companies — Phase 1 data engine (source-backed, static site on Cloudflare Pages).
comment: No runtime dependencies are pinned here on purpose. The GitHub Actions workflows install what they need with `npm install <pkg> --no-save` (pdfjs-dist, plus optional email libs) so the frontend has nothing to build. For local dev run: `npm install pdfjs-dist --no-save`.
